content.text:
No, not yet. `src/services/user-service.js` still calls the callback-style `query` and `update` from `src/db.js` directly (`src/services/user-service.js:1`). A comment in the file says it's waiting to be moved over: "Chapter 5 migrates this to UserRepository."

The repository it would switch to already exists. `UserRepository` in `src/repositories/user-repository.js` has a promise-based method for each of the service's three functions:

| Service function (callback) | Repository method (promise) |
|---|---|
| `listActiveUsers(cb)` | `findActive()` |
| `findUser(id, cb)` | `findById(id)` |
| `softDeleteUser(id, when, cb)` | `softDelete(id, when)` |

The project's `migrate-module` skill does this conversion for one service file at a time and then runs that file's tests. I can run it on `user-service.js` if you want. Switching to the repository changes the functions from callbacks to promises, so anything that calls them, such as `src/api/routes.js`, may need updating too.
